name: ptr-replace-no-leading-slash-invalid
comment: §3.7 (D2): replace with path "foo" (no leading /) is a malformed whole-pointer -> INVALID_POINTER, NOT an alias to the root document

name: ptr-move-from-no-leading-slash-invalid
comment: §3.7 (D2): move whose `from` is "foo" (no leading /) -> INVALID_POINTER on the read-side source too (whole-pointer syntax error precedes read/write resolution)
